name: 33584 · Seffner, FL
findings: ZIP 33584 (Seffner) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33584 (Seffner) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33584 (Seffner) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).
